source: Direct user clarification during the sv-billie adapter review
statement: I think it's ok if our LoRA requires style prompts and trigger words associated with koan to perform good remixes. That's been the case for both sa3 and ace-step loras too.
neutral_prompts_role: Optional diagnostic, not a production acceptance gate.
still_required: No dataset reference recording needed at inference.
Keep new scores/input audio as musical content; evaluate melody/chords separately from style.
Compare identical style prompts with and without the adapter to attribute its contribution.
Evaluate degradation and repeatability across fixed seeds/content.

proposed_trigger.status: Proposed future training alias, not an established trigger for the existing checkpoints.

historical_evidence: Previous neutral-caption tests remain valid under their original conditions; they are not the sole acceptance criterion for the clarified prompted workflow.
